messages:
zoe_mkt: New launch post draft up for a quick lock: https://docs.example.com/launch-mini-v1. Need signoff on benchmark phrasing, CTA split by region, and JP/DE short CTAs. Can we lock by tomorrow AM? :sunrise:

ash_growth: I can take CTAs and A/B plan. Recommend two variants: Webinar-first vs Quickstart-first. Will add GA event names `launch_cta` and `launch_variant`.

michael_pm: Benchmark source is internal bench-v3 on identical A100 config. Current line reads '30% faster p99'  prefer safer: "~30% lower p99 latency (internal tests)" and include a brief methodology block.

rachel_legal: Legal-safe wording suggestion: "Based on internal benchmark v3 comparing Redwood runtime to OpenModelX on identical hardware. Methodology: 3,000 requests; mixed sequence lengths; p99 measured across 5 runs." Avoid superlatives like "guarantee" or "industry-leading."

leo_ops: For ops playbook, routing mapping example: ```region_map = {"NA":"sales-na","EU":"sales-eu","APAC":"partners-apac"}``` Webinar capacity: EU slots Tue/Thu 10am CET, cap 40 -> auto-waitlist at 40. Add UTM: `?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=launch_mini&utm_variant=A|B`.

zoe_mkt: Thanks all  Ive applied Rachel's wording and Leo's routing snippet and added CTAs from Ash. Link updated to v2. If no objections by tomorrow morning I'll lock copy and hand to ops. :rocket:
